body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Motorola(www.motorola.com) unveiled concept product which can be used as laptop after loading 'ARTRIX', the smartphone of new Android platform with Dual Core processor at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
